system.description:
You make contact with the ground and release a stream of sharp crystals to bind and pierce creatures in its path. All creatures in the jutsu’s range, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 4d8 earth damage, and gain a rank of Bleed. On a success they take half as much damage.

The affected area becomes jagged in crystal pillars, becoming difficult terrain until cleared.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can cross the newly created difficult terrain with no challenge, ignoring the movement penalty. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu’s range can instead be Self (30-Foot Cone). If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, creatures who fail their saving throw has their movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.
